name: AgentMemory
description: Long-term agent memory entries (facts, preferences, skills, summaries). Each row has a pgvector embedding for RAG retrieval. Scoped per (idOfUser, agentName, tenantId) — UI agent's memories don't bleed into domain agents. Writes go through the save_memory() platform tool, not data_create. Used by the Generative UI agent runtime (plan-29).

attributes.name: uuid
attributes.description: Plan-36 — parquet-friendly natural key. UUIDv4 set at INSERT (MemoryService when persisting via the save_memory tool). Stays stable for the row's lifetime. Used as the parquet primary key in future analytics dumps.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owner of this memory entry. representsOwnership drives the ownership filter (52-D.2 / 52-D.3).

attributes.name: agentName
attributes.description: Scopes memory per-agent; UI agent's memory is separate from domain agents'

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The memory itself, in natural language

attributes.name: sourceConversationId
attributes.description: Optional back-link to the AgentConversation this memory was extracted from

attributes.name: confidence
attributes.description: Agent's self-rated confidence in this memory (0.0-1.0)

attributes.name: lastAccessedAt
attributes.description: Updated on each retrieval — drives future LRU pruning

attributes.name: expiresAt
attributes.description: Optional epoch-ms after which the memory stops being retrieved. NULL or 0 = never expires. Drives the WHERE clause in MemoryController.searchMemory.

attributes.name: embedding
attributes.description: pgvector embedding (gemini text-embedding-004 = 768 dimensions). HNSW index on the cosine operator class for similarity retrieval (<=> operator).
